metadata.purpose: Forward up to count values, then complete and release the source subscription.

conditions: The count n is a nonnegative safe integer.
The bound counts next notifications, not lifecycle actions.
Reaching n values completes; an earlier source terminal or cancellation may stop with fewer values.

scope.parameters: count is a nonnegative safe integer
scope.callbacks: No supplied callback; observers must not reenter, cancel during delivery, or throw.
scope.time: No internal clock; caller supplies nonnegative trace times and same-time order.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant steps, observed at quiescence. No nested delivery model.
exclusions: Negative/fractional counts, NaN, Infinity and unsafe integers.
Nested synchronous input and cancellation inside notification handlers.
Teardown exceptions, unrelated external resources, and arbitrary source side effects.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Only when count > 0; count = 0 completes without acquisition.

ownership.sharing: No sharing introduced; source hot/cold character is preserved.
ownership.reset: Each run creates fresh state; no reset within a closed execution.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Ordered notification calls and source lifecycle observations at quiescence, not an effect interpreter. Release is idempotent and does not prescribe every internal finalizer microstep.
cancellationCheckpoints: Before the next external input; cancellation emits no complete notification.
Intra-notification cancellation is outside this atomic profile.

controls.description: source connected; seen values are below the quota
terminated or cancelled; no further legal inputs

rules.explanation: When the requested count is zero, subscribing completes the result immediately. The source is never subscribed to.
actions: complete downstream without subscribing to the source
rules.nextState: closed because the quota is zero

rules.explanation: When the requested count is positive, subscribing creates a fresh counter and subscribes to the source. Constructing the model or pipeline does not connect the source.
Each source value is forwarded unchanged while the accepted-value count remains below the requested limit. The operator remembers how many values it has forwarded.
rules.nextState: active with seen increased by one

rules.explanation: When the value that reaches the limit arrives, the operator forwards that value, completes the result, and releases the source subscription. The source need not complete first.
rules.nextState: closed because the quota was reached

rules.explanation: When the source completes before the limit, the result completes with the values already forwarded. No extra value is produced, and the source subscription is released.
When the source errors before the limit, the same error is forwarded and the source subscription is released. No completion notification follows the error.
When downstream unsubscribes before termination, the source subscription is released. Unsubscription does not send a completion notification.
actions: release the source subscription without notifying downstream
